# Among The Letters - Full Description for LLMs

Canonical website: https://amongtheletters.com
RSS: https://amongtheletters.substack.com/feed
X: https://x.com/AmongtheLetters
Newsletter (Substack): https://amongtheletters.substack.com/
Contact: amongtheletters@gmail.com
Established: 2026

## What it is

Among The Letters is a free daily reading newsletter for anyone who enjoys reading, in every genre. Each afternoon it shares a few stories, poems, and essays that are free to read online, along with books and authors worth knowing. Every piece is picked by hand, every link is checked, and each day of the week has its own genre. The tone is considered and practical rather than noisy.

One-line summary: Free stories, poems, and essays worth your afternoon, picked and checked daily, with a different genre each day.

Readers who also write get useful extras: Monday Morning Opportunities (checked writing work, contests, grants, residencies, and calls for submissions), free printable tools and a plain-language glossary on the website, and two paid PDF guides. These are a secondary track, not the main purpose of the newsletter.

## Editions

### Afternoon Discoveries (daily)

The main edition, published every day, Sunday through Saturday. Shares stories, poems, and essays that are free to read online, plus books, authors, literary magazines, writing projects, emerging voices, forthcoming work, interviews, criticism, craft, literary journalism, and carefully chosen older or overlooked material as Special Recommendations.

Regular Afternoon Discoveries posts contain a useful free section followed by an expanded paid section.

Afternoon Discoveries follows a seven-day genre rhythm:

- Monday: Literary Fiction & Poetry
- Tuesday: Science Fiction & Fantasy
- Wednesday: Mystery, Thriller, Crime, Horror, & Dark Fiction
- Thursday: Romance, Women's Fiction, & Historical Fiction
- Friday: Nonfiction, Memoir, Essays, & Narrative Journalism
- Saturday: Speculative, Hybrid, Experimental, Short, & Flash Fiction
- Sunday: Emerging Writers, Debuts, & Reading Worth Revisiting

### Morning Opportunities (Mondays, for readers who write)

Published on Mondays only. Gathers legitimate opportunities for writers, including:

- Paid writing and editorial work
- Literary contests and prizes
- Grants and fellowships
- Residencies
- Calls for submissions
- Other worthwhile opportunities for writers

Listings emphasize useful details, clear requirements, and primary or authoritative sources. Deadlines, eligibility, fees, pay, prizes, and application details are included when they can be confirmed. Secondary roundups may help uncover a lead, but they are not treated as the final source.

Regular Morning Opportunities posts contain a useful free section followed by an expanded paid section.

### Weekly Discoveries Roundup (Sunday evening, paid)

Published on Sunday evenings for paid subscribers, in addition to the regular Sunday Afternoon Discoveries edition. It is a compact catch-up that gathers:

- Every Featured Discovery from the week
- Concise day-by-day summaries with read-more links
- A small set of Monday opportunities that remain timely, when useful

The Sunday roundup is a complete paid-subscriber post rather than a free section followed by an internal paywall.

## Free vs paid

- Free: The free portion of daily Afternoon Discoveries and of Monday Morning Opportunities. Free sections are designed to be genuinely useful on their own, not teasers with the useful part missing.
- Full ($5 per month on Substack): Everything in the free edition, plus expanded Monday opportunity roundups, expanded Afternoon Discoveries every day, Special Recommendations and deeper context, and the paid-subscriber-only Weekly Discoveries Roundup every Sunday.
- Founding lifetime membership ($299 CAD): An early founding offer separate from the standard monthly Substack plan. Includes lifetime access to the paid newsletter plus select future Among The Letters products released outside Substack. Inquiries: amongtheletters@gmail.com.

Standard newsletter subscriptions, publishing, and billing are handled through Substack.

## Public archive policy

The website archive at https://amongtheletters.com/archive/ displays published Afternoon Discoveries editions that have been intentionally approved for public PDF access. Each archive card opens the corresponding PDF.

Morning Opportunities and the Sunday Weekly Discoveries Roundup are not listed on the public archive. Files in /newsletters/ are publicly accessible PDFs of Afternoon Discoveries only.

## Editorial principles

- Useful before impressive: find something you can actually read tonight, and, for readers who write, something to enter, apply for, or submit to.
- Check before sharing: every link is checked, and opportunity details are checked against primary or authoritative sources; links return to the source.
- Curiosity without the noise: a considered gathering rather than shouting.
- Leave room to wander: older essays, emerging writers, and unexpected books can matter as much as trends.
